主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on February 11, 2021. The filing includes a press release dated February 11, 2021. The report is submitted under Regulation S-T Rule 101(b)(7), indicating it is intended to fulfill legal requirements in the registrant's home country or on the home country exchange where its securities are traded. The filing does not include a press release and is not distributed to security holders. The report is related to the registrant's obligations under the laws of its jurisdiction of incorporation, domicile, or legal organization. The filing is signed by Justin Beber, Head of Corporate Strategy and Chief Legal Officer, on behalf of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. on February 11, 2021.
